Never kill police or foreign criminals. Worst case, L has timing, regional and web. Then he keeps students, night workers and people at home (55%), in my region (10%), who read web forums (30%). That is about 165k people, above the 100k limit. Adding police or foreign, or spreading quick kills into the morning, would push the pool below 100k. Expect press conferences to show about 200k at the lowest. If one shows 100k or less, something is wrong, so stop.
